questions.q: Put these FBDI pipeline steps in the correct order: (1) run the product-specific import process, (2) generate CSV files, (3) upload the ZIP to UCM, (4) populate the template.
questions.explain: The order is: populate the template, generate CSV files, zip and upload to UCM, run Load Interface File for Import, then run the product-specific import process.

questions.q: What does the 'Load Interface File for Import' scheduled process actually do?
options: It creates final, live application records directly
It reads the uploaded ZIP file out of UCM and loads its contents into interface tables
It deletes the uploaded file permanently
It emails the finance team a confirmation
questions.explain: Load Interface File for Import only moves data from the uploaded ZIP into the staging interface tables. It does not create real application records.

questions.q: Which step in the pipeline is the FIRST one that actually creates real, live application records?
options: Running Load Interface File for Import
Running the product-specific import process (e.g. Import Payables Invoices)
questions.explain: Everything before the product-specific import process only affects staging. Real records are created only when that second process validates and accepts a row.

questions.q: Why is it safe to re-run 'Load Interface File for Import' multiple times while troubleshooting a file?
options: Because it only affects the staging interface table, not live application data
Because it has no effect on anything, ever, under any circumstance
Because Oracle automatically undoes any mistake
It isn't safe — it should never be re-run
questions.explain: Since this step only loads data into a staging interface table, re-running it does not affect real application records, which only change once the product-specific import process runs.

questions.q: What mistake is described as one of the most common beginner errors in Oracle Fusion data loading?
options: Using too many templates at once
Assuming the data is fully loaded after only uploading the file or running Load Interface File for Import, without running the second, product-specific import process
Zipping the CSV files before uploading
Downloading the wrong color of template
questions.explain: Uploading and staging data is not the same as importing it. Skipping or forgetting the second, product-specific import step is a very common early mistake.
